searchIndex.title: Search index status
searchIndex.description: Search indexes managed by TionHarness for the agent, with one row for each (tool, root) pair. The list is process-wide: two workspaces that open the same repository share one store on disk. Refresh re-embeds while keeping existing vectors, Rebuild deletes the store and creates it again, and Delete removes the index from disk after you type its root path. For codebase-memory, refresh indexes incrementally; rebuild and delete remove the project from the server's own store.
searchIndex.empty: There are no managed indexes yet. When a session opens with a zvec-grep or codebase-memory MCP server configured, its working directory is indexed in the background and appears here.
searchIndex.refreshTitle: Re-embed while preserving the current store

searchIndex.rebuildTitle: Delete the store and build it again — required after an embedding-model change
searchIndex.dropTitle: Delete the index from disk (requires typing the root path)

stepKinds.introSuffix: . Each type below shows its meaning, whether it is persisted or live-only, and whether it is currently active.

text.label: Text
text.description: Intermediate narrative text produced by the model between tool calls.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.description: Model reasoning content when the provider supplies it.

tool.label: Tool
tool.description: A single tool call with its input and result. Edit and Write output is shown as a diff.

delta.label: Stream chunk
delta.description: A live text fragment received while the reply is generated token by token. Temporary; the complete text is written to the message.

ask.label: Question
ask.description: The ask_user tool asks a question and waits for the user's answer, suspending the turn. Temporary; it becomes a persisted tool step after the answer.

permission.label: Permission approval
permission.description: An approval gate waits for permission before a write or command tool. Temporary; the tool runs or a permission_denied error is recorded after the decision.

plan.label: Plan approval
plan.description: A Claude CLI agent presents its plan with ExitPlanMode and waits for approval. The turn continues after approval or the model revises the plan after rejection.

todo.label: Task list
todo.description: The todo_write tool's working checklist, rendered as a first-class card.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.description: The loop left its normal path, for example after reaching an iteration limit. Reason carries a machine label.

error.label: Error
error.description: A turn-level error such as a provider failure, budget overrun, or cancellation, separate from a tool error.

steer.label: Steering
steer.description: Live user guidance added to a running turn, shown separately from model output.

tool_delta.label: Tool output stream
tool_delta.description: Kept only for reading older persisted sessions. New tool-output chunks use the generic Append contract.

tombstone.label: Withdrawal
tombstone.description: Removes a live step whose final card cannot arrive because of cancellation or panic. The tombstone itself is not rendered.

diff.label: File change
diff.description: A file change made by Write or Edit, shown with its path, added and removed line counts, and an expandable unified diff.

hook.label: Hook
hook.description: A user-defined PreToolUse or PostToolUse hook ran around a tool call and changed input or output, approved it, added context, or blocked it.

context_change.label: Context change
context_change.description: The session's frozen persona, instructions, skills, or tool catalog changed. The cached prefix keeps its session-start snapshot until the next context refresh.

cache_break.label: Cache break
cache_break.description: This turn lost the session's warm prompt-cache prefix and paid for it again. Cards are shown for model, system-prompt, or tool-schema changes.

compaction.label: Context compaction
compaction.description: Session history was folded into a rolling summary to stay within the context budget. Raw messages remain unchanged on disk.

subagent.label: Subagent
subagent.description: An isolated subagent runs a task in a clean context and returns only its final result, with its own nested trace available in the expandable card.

workspace.introSuffix: . Every agent has an explicit provider and model; new agents inherit the setup of the first existing agent.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.terseHint: Adds a concise-response instruction to each agent's static system prompt in this workspace. It removes filler, pleasantries, and hedging while preserving code, commands, paths, and errors verbatim. Edit the prompt under Prompts ▸ Terse (caveman) response style. Changes reach open sessions after /refresh-context or in a new session.
workspace.codebaseMemoryHint: When this workspace has a codebase-memory MCP server, agents receive a knowledge-graph hint, use an isolated workspace index store, automatically index session working directories, and can use codebase_workspace_search. Off disables this integration completely.
workspace.zvecHint: When this workspace has a zvec-grep MCP server, agents receive semantic-search guidance, the tool is exempt from their allowlist, and missing working-directory indexes are built in the background. Off disables the integration while leaving configured MCP tools visible.
workspace.codexPluginsHint: When enabled, codex-cli turns use the configured marketplaces and plugins. They are installed once per persistent chat home. Auxiliary title, summary, and insight calls do not install plugins. TionHarness does not include its own marketplace.
workspace.promptEpochHint: Freezes a session's static system prompt and tool schemas at session start so mid-session skill, setting, instruction, and MCP changes do not break the prompt cache. They apply on compaction, model change, /refresh-context, or a new session.
workspace.sqzLabel: Compress large shell output with sqz
workspace.sqzHint: Compresses Bash or PowerShell command output in process before it reaches the model. The live UI keeps the raw output. Automatic follows the sqz hook; On requires the sqz binary; Off disables it.
workspace.sqzAuto: Automatic (when the sqz hook is connected)
workspace.rtkLabel: Run test and build commands through rtk
workspace.rtkHint: Rewrites measured test, build, lint, and selected Git commands before execution to produce less output. The agent receives a summary that preserves failures with file and line locations. Automatic follows the rtk hook; On requires the rtk binary; Off disables it.
workspace.rtkAuto: Automatic (when the rtk hook is connected)
workspace.deleteHint: Permanently delete this workspace and all of its data.

zvec.title: zvec-grep integration
zvec.description: When a zvec-grep MCP server is added, TionHarness adds a semantic workspace search available block to the agent context, fills a missing root from the working directory, exempts the tool from the agent allowlist, and indexes the session working directory in the background when needed. The index is written to .zvec-grep/, excluded through .git/info/exclude, and built with local/potion-code-16m-v2. Toggle this under Settings ▸ This workspace.
zvec.installFirst: zg must be on PATH first and appear as installed above
zvec.addTitle: Add the MCP server automatically (zg server --stdio)
zvec.notFound: zg was not found on PATH.
zvec.connected: MCP server added ({{name}}) — agents can use it.
zvec.notConnected: MCP server has not been added.
